description: Fetch the record of one end user: their saved data, public info, purchases and communications thread. It holds personal data of the app's users, so it is returned for the account that owns the app only. Use the `_id` from neblla_list_users / neblla_search_users_by_email as `userId`.

env.description: Whose data: "pro" (the users', default) or "pre" (the app's pre, its own users and data unless it plays with pro's)

userId.description: The user's mongo ObjectId hex string (the `_id` returned by neblla_list_users)

name: neblla_get_user
title: Get user
